subject: Post-call: spend heatmap & buy-cycle alignment
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@clearbridgepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: spend heatmap & buy-cycle alignment

Hi Sophie / Alex —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap while the notes are fresh and a proposed path forward. Full attachments: clearbridge-spend-heatmap.xlsx (spread by flow + per-call token delta) and mutual-action-plan.docx (draft MAP).

Key pain points you called out:
- Token run rate is spiking at peak times and the team is worried about runaway spend if usage scales.
- Heavy assistant/chat flows where users re-open context repeatedly — large repeated prefix tokens.
- Desire for predictable monthly TCO for budget sign-off; procurement needs a clear ROI case.

Goals for a successful pilot / evaluation:
1) Demonstrate steady-state per-month cost under anticipated traffic (100k MAU opt-in target).
2) Prove 30–45% unit-cost reduction on chat flows via batching + prefix/KV caching.
3) Define a rollout path with measurable ROI at 3, 6 months and procurement-ready pricing.

Preliminary economics we discussed (back-of-envelope):
- Current observed: ~2.4k tokens per active conversation on average, ~18 tokens/sec peak throughput for the bot.
- Batch-friendly requests (~45% of calls): intelligent batching could reduce compute tokens by ~20–35% depending on latency SLO.
- Prefix/KV cache reuse (chat): we estimate up to ~35–45% token savings for conversation reopen flows once prefix caching is configured.
- Model/quantization levers: switching to a quantized variant for non-sensitive routes can lower inference cost ~15–25% (subject to quality verification).

Suggested pilot approach (2–4 weeks):
- Week 0: Instrumentation + confirm sample traffic to generate the spend heatmap (we sent the attached).
- Week 1–2: Canary with batching enabled + prefix cache on 10–20% of traffic; measure latency and token delta.
- Week 3–4: Roll to 50% and finalize ROI numbers and an SOW for production.

Open asks for you / procurement to confirm:
- Ballpark monthly budget range procurement can commit to for a pilot (e.g., $15–35k/mo). Knowing the range lets us shape the MAP and the scale of the canary.
- Any restricted time windows or regulatory checkpoints we should schedule into the timeline.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sophie: confirm budget band and preferred date window for a technical deep-dive next week.
- Marissa: I requested an SOW + pricing sheet (cc'd).
- Ben: please prepare a brief quantization/variant matrix and a simple cost-per-1000-token sensitivity table for the call.

If that aligns, I'll record the MAP in HubSpot and share dates.

Thanks —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0194
Attachments: clearbridge-spend-heatmap.xlsx (spreadsheet), mutual-action-plan.docx (draft)
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@clearbridgepay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@clearbridgepay.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: spend heatmap & buy-cycle alignment

Thanks Rafael — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Budget constraints: procurement has already signaled an initial pilot ceiling of about $20k/month unless we can show deterministic >30% savings within 30 days.
- Usage numbers (for your modeling): ~85k monthly active users, ~15% of those hit the bot daily. Avg tokens per interaction currently ~2.2k (we'll confirm with telemetry but this is the working number).
- Security: any quantized model route must avoid PII routing for now — we can scope that during the deep-dive.

We want a tighter ROI snapshot before committing to a 2–4 week canary. Can you produce a 2-scenario ROI (conservative / optimistic) using the attached heatmap and our base usage? If you also share a clean SOW + pricing punchlist I can push it to procurement / legal next week.

Available slots for tech-deep-dive: Mon 9/8 10–12 PT or Tue 9/9 14–16 PT.

Appreciate it —
Sophie
Sophie Lee
Head of Platform Engineering | ClearBridge Pay
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: spend heatmap & buy-cycle alignment

Rafael / Ben — quick internal note. I'll draft the SOW (2 pages) and the pilot pricing sheet (line items: engineering hours, pilot run compute, support SLAs, optional quantization validation).

Raf: for the canary, do you prefer we start with 10% traffic with batching + no quantized routes, or 5% with batching + a subset of quantized non-PII flows? Procurement will likely favor the smaller, lower-risk option.

Ben: can you pull the cost-per-1k-tokens table and the GPU utilization delta for the two quantization options? Attach to the SOW draft so Sophie/procurement can see the assumptions.

On it —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@clearbridgepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: spend heatmap & buy-cycle alignment

Sophie — thanks. That budget ceiling is helpful and matches what I expected.

Plan: we’ll produce two quick ROI scenarios (conservative / optimistic) using your 85k MAU baseline and the attached heatmap. Marissa is drafting the SOW and Ben will attach the cost-per-1k table and utilization deltas.

I booked the tech-deep-dive for Mon 9/8 10:30–11:30 PT (studio link: https://meet.redwood.ai/raf-clarify). I recorded a brief MAP inside HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4387/DEAL-4721 — please confirm that the stakeholders listed there are correct (I added Alex as the procurement contact).

Requested from you: confirm the budget ceiling and whether procurement can sign a 30-day pilot SOW for $20k/mo if we show the conservative scenario meets >25% net unit savings. If procurement needs different contract language (e.g., refund/credit if savings don't materialize), flag that and Marissa will work it into the SOW.

I'll follow up with the ROI scenarios and a one-page exec summary by EOD Monday.

Best,
Rafael
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx (draft MAP)
